campaign_name: PR-EG-R2B — Authorized Speech Contract & Information Integrity
purpose: Focused architectural investigation and controlled feasibility; no production implementation.
executive_summary:
# 01 — Executive Summary

**C — CONTAINMENT REPAIR REQUIRED FIRST.** Architectural outcome C: the proposed natural-language contract is not ready as a production enforcement boundary. Keep the existing authority owners; do not implement PR-EG-R3 or PR-EH.

An explicit resolver-derived evidence projection is feasible for a selected authored topic and grounded speaker. Existing state does not provide a comprehensive atom-level, epistemically typed knowledge/disclosure grant. A structured contract alone therefore neither supplies missing authority nor proves generated claims comply.

FRESH narrow contract evaluation: 102 byte-identical historical candidates plus 10 separately frozen supplemental cases. Historical development: 24/30 safe accepted, 2/39 unsafe accepted (one high risk). Historical holdout: 11/12 safe accepted, 0/16 unsafe accepted, one safe rejected. All ten supplemental decisions matched labels. Historical holdout is previously exposed, not independent qualification. The unsafe permission rule was rejected in a single-case repeat; this variance does not erase the original ACCEPT. The false-ignorance acceptance also remains a failure.

LOCAL exact historical handler failure reproduced: unsupported north-gate vulnerability delivered and retained after two narration calls. Matched safe/unsafe trials have equal final world state. Ten additional handler probes show wording-sensitive refusal, overwrites, rejected candidates omitted from history, and legitimate resolver-authorized security information preserved. They do not implement or enforce the experimental contract.

Recommend a separate host-owned speech-adoption containment repair using existing authored answers, bounded personal responses and knowledge-appropriate nonbinding responses, with one final adoption/persistence identity. This sacrifices open incidental improvisation temporarily but preserves useful factual answers and simple conversation. Its viability is a proposal, not a demonstrated production fix. All 41 focused tests passed; protected production/test/tool/save hashes unchanged. External review is required before further work.

Evidence classes: STATIC = current source inspection; LOCAL = executed current production functions with disposable fixtures and external wire doubles; FRESH = new provider request; HISTORICAL = retained predecessor evidence; REPLAY = recombination of measured results; INFERENCE = proposed design; UNVERIFIED = not exercised. No fresh full-production API test was performed.

production: None; protected game/data/tests/tools and active saves hash-identical.
validation: Research-only comparisons against existing validator and explicit synthetic speech contracts.
tooling: New artifact-only frozen experiments, exact handler reconstruction, metrics and review packaging.
documentation: 24 required reports; proposed ownership, minimal contract and separate containment plan.
generated_artifacts: 112 local validator A/B comparisons; 112 fresh narrow decisions; 11 generated outputs; 12 local handler probes; diagnostics, usage, latency and 41-pass junit.

testing.focused: 41 passed, 2 deselected using the retained R2A focused selection; focused_junit.xml.
testing.runtime_validation: Ten A–J handler probes and two matched exact historical controls; synchronous production functions with external wire doubles. No safety gates patched.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: gpt-4.1-mini returned gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14; Responses; default sampling; cap 3500; timeout 45s; SDK retries 0. Raw transport failure retained and recovered.
testing.new_regressions: No focused-test failure; no production edit. Unsafe speech, false acceptance/rejection and overwrites remain unfixed.
testing.pre_existing_failures: Historical 19 not re-established; existing dirty worktree retained.

campaign_specific: Exact unsupported security claim delivered and persisted.
Contract-relative checker accepts unsupported operational rule and false ignorance.
One critical single-case repeat rejects an earlier accepted claim; no safety inference from the repeat.
Road paraphrase false rejections and downstream overwrites; existing experimental contract metadata is not consumed by production.
pre_existing: Large strict-social narration and historical regression debt.

missing_concepts: Source/disclosure/epistemic provenance retained from resolver to adoption.
Final text-to-authority binding and noncanonical legacy-history safeguards.
Independent untouched holdouts and fresh full-production qualification.
decisions_requiring_human_review: Review final verdict C and the separate proposed containment repair before R3.
does_not_prove: Production semantic enforcement, a working containment repair or natural contract-bounded generation readiness.
Independent holdout generalization or safety from structured metadata.
Fresh full-production API correctness, latency distribution, current prices or account billing.
Unchanged world state implies safe speech.
recommended_next_step: External review of R2B. Separately scope a bounded host-owned speech containment repair; do not implement PR-EG-R3 or PR-EH.
